maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The uppermost row of keypoints is positioned approximately 1.5 times the average spot diameter dorsal to the primary dense row, aligned roughly parallel to the upper labial margin.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The rhinarium surface displays approximately 96% melanin saturation, with minor depigmented/pale pixel clusters localized primarily along the superior-lateral ridges and the nasal bridge transition.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent vertical philtrum groove is visible bisecting the muzzle; high-contrast boundary present between the tawny maxillary fur and the white circum-oral fur.
